verdict.rationale: Azure's REST API reference pages on Microsoft Learn carry a first-party Try It console that executes real requests against management.azure.com, which makes the reference interactive and its examples runnable. Canonical Swagger/TypeSpec specs in Azure/azure-rest-api-specs back the reference. Execution requires Microsoft sign-in and runs against the caller's real subscription, with no sandbox, and the button is injected client-side. Missing for 10: a sandboxed or no-login way to run examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of the Try It experience, and broader documentation of example coverage across services.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
